about: Gephi JSON's style vocabulary: every key the Gephi JSON Exporter plugin writes (its model classes GraphElement, GraphNode and GraphEdge, serialized by Gson's default toJson: nulls left out, HTML characters escaped as \u003c and so on, doubles with a decimal point), and the sigma.js defaults that decide how sigma draws a file that says nothing more. gephi-json.mjs checks every key here has a specimen or a reason, and that sigma's live DEFAULT_SETTINGS still equal sigmaSettings (--vocabulary rewrites that part from the pinned sigma).
program: Gephi JSON Exporter plugin (oxfordinternetinstitute/gephi-plugins, branch jsonexporter-plugin)

document.note: The exporter puts both arrays in a HashMap, so Gson writes edges before nodes; the order of elements in each array is a HashSet's, not the graph's.

attributes.from: every column but id and label, toString(), nulls left out; written as {} when there are none; not drawn

color.from: the edge's own rgb when e.alpha() != 0, else EdgeColor MIXED of the source and target colors (written as one rgb, so a file cannot tell the two apart)

attributes.from: every column that is not a property and not weight; written as {} when there are none; not drawn. An older build of the plugin also wrote the weight column, titled Weight (the corpus export gephi-worldcup.json.gz has "Weight": "1.0" on every edge)

notWritten.about: What a Gephi workspace has that the exporter never writes, so no Gephi JSON file can carry it.

exporterOptions.exportVisible: the visible graph (graphModel.getGraphVisible()) or the whole graph: which elements are written, never how they look

sigmaDisplayDefaults.about: sigma 4.0.1's DEFAULT_NODE_DISPLAY_DATA and DEFAULT_EDGE_DISPLAY_DATA (sigma/dist/types-*.js) for what the file leaves out: the default specimens show them.

sigmaSettings.about: The pinned sigma's DEFAULT_SETTINGS that change what a Gephi JSON file looks like (the oracle draws with sigma's defaults: the file carries no settings).
